scripts.sandbox:wasm: cd ../backend && GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go build -trimpath -ldflags='-s -w' -o ../frontend/public-sandbox/codetroc.wasm ./cmd/sandbox && gzip -9f ../frontend/public-sandbox/codetroc.wasm && mv ../frontend/public-sandbox/codetroc.wasm.gz ../frontend/public-sandbox/codetroc.gz.wasm && cp "$(go env GOROOT)/lib/wasm/wasm_exec.js" ../frontend/public-sandbox/ && cp ../frontend/node_modules/@electric-sql/pglite/dist/pglite.data ../frontend/public-sandbox/pglite-fs.wasm
scripts.build:sandbox: npm run sandbox:wasm && tsc --noEmit && VITE_DATA=api VITE_SANDBOX=1 vite build --mode sandbox --base ./ --outDir dist-sandbox
